messages.author: 95775cc24c0038f6
messages.subject: Reading files from Cassandra
parts:
Is it possible to to read data from Cassandra in in Spark?
In SparkR, one can write statements which will read data from HDFS through textFile API.
If there any API to read from Cassandra?
Thank you

messages.author: f4108b5f63668d70
messages.subject: Re: Reading files from Cassandra
parts:
The method we are following in SparkR is to use the Spark data sources API [1] as the unified way to read in data from various sources like JDBC, HBase, CSV, JSON etc. However as far as I know we don't have a data source implementation for Cassandra yet.

Thanks
Shivaram

[1] https://databricks.com/blog/2015/01/09/spark-sql-data-sources-api-unified-data-access-for-the-spark-platform.html
